subject: general
question: What is the one-word substitute for: "A person who has a strong desire to travel and explore the world."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dromomaniac**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dromomaniac"** refers to a person who has an uncontrollable psychological urge to wander or travel excessively. (यात्रा करने की अत्यधिक इच्छा रखने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **His dromomania led him to explore every continent before the age of 30.
 
 
• This word perfectly describes someone with an intense desire to travel and explore the world, as mentioned in the question.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Dromomaniac**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Philoprogenitive** (संतान प्रेमी): Refers to a person who is fond of children or has many offspring.
 
 
• **Example: **Her philoprogenitive nature made her the favorite aunt among all her nieces and nephews.
 
 

 
• **Philopraxic** (व्यावहारिकता प्रेमी): Refers to someone who loves or is inclined towards practical actions or practices.
 
 
• **Example: **Her philopraxic approach to education emphasizes hands-on learning over theoretical concepts.
 
 

 
• **Chrematistic** (धन-संबंधी): Relates to the pursuit of wealth or material gain.
 
 
• **Example: **His chrematistic ambitions led him to pursue a career in investment banking.
